text:
Anya Patel: quick check — I'm onboarding goliath-65b-v2 weights from HF. HF path: https://huggingface.co/org/goliath-65b-v2/resolve/main/weights/ckpt-0001.bin ..ckpt-0008.bin. planning to mirror under s3://redwood-artifacts/models/goliath-65b-v2/2026-03-17/. can folks confirm the mirroring pattern and checksum expectations?
Mike Huang: ran a quick diff on shard 1 — `sha256sum ckpt-0001.bin` -> 3a1f2b... but the manifest.json lists 9b2c7d... mismatch. did HF change storage compression?
registry-bot: note — repo uses manifest_v2. manifest 'sha256' is expected to be the digest of the concatenated raw weights blob (not per-shard blob) for older exports. new HF exports set per-shard sha256. please indicate which convention you used.
Anya Patel: ugh. we pulled the HF per-shard files (no concat). I assumed per-shard checksums. should we regenerate manifest with per-shard sha256s?
Jen Ortega: also flagging a tokenizer quirk — tokenizer.json from HF has `unk_token: null` and uses sentencepiece with 0 reserved IDs. loader fails with `ValueError: vocab size mismatch (expected 50257, got 50256)`. I think one special token missing.
Ravi Shah: that vocab error shows up in our CI model-validator: `./tools/validate_model.sh --weights s3://redwood-artifacts/models/goliath-65b-v2/2026-03-17/` -> returns `ERR: tokenizer.vocab_size != config.vocab_size`. quick fix is to add `<unk>` at index 50256 or bump config.vocab_size. which do we want?
Priya Menon: about S3 access — infra requires the onboarding job to assume role `ai-artifact-consumer`. if you need presigned links for temporary mirror, run `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-artifacts/models/goliath-65b-v2/ckpt-0001.bin --expires-in 7200` from infra account. I can grant read to `redwood-onboarder` svcacct if you @me.
Mike Huang: small note: HF token scope matters for large file download. we used an HF repo token with `read` only. if anyone else hits 403, check `HF_TOKEN` in the runner.
Anya Patel: flagged @Priya for role. also, do we want to keep shards as-is or upload a single `weights.bin` (concat + gzip)? pros/cons?
Leo Kim: keep shards. Dedicated runtime can stream shards in parallel which lowers mem pressure. but update manifest to clearly state per-shard sha256 and file_size fields. i'll draft a manifest patch.
Jen Ortega: +1 for shard approach. for tokenizer, i'll push a tiny patch to tokenizers repo to insert missing unk if absent and add a sanity check in the loader: `if tokenizer.vocab_size != config.vocab_size: raise ConfigError(...)` with a helpful message.
Ravi Shah: CI note — the model-validator currently fails the entire pipeline for tokenizer mismatch. ci-bot, can we change it to a soft-fail with a link to an onboarding checklist?
ci-bot: created ticket ML-5432 — 'validator: soft-fail for tokenizer mismatch + onboarding checklist link'. assigned to Ravi Shah and Jen Ortega.
Anya Patel: mike/leo — can you double-check the presign TTL and manifest format before I trigger the mirror? want to avoid re-upload. aim to mirror today EOD. :clock3:
Mike Huang: doing a dry run now. will post sha256 list once done. :eyes:
Leo Kim: drafting manifest update in PR 482, pinging @Jen for CR. will include per-shard checksums and a `tokenizer_hint` field indicating special tokens.
Priya Menon: granted `ai-artifact-consumer` to `redwood-onboarder` svcacct. you should be able to `aws s3 ls s3://redwood-artifacts/models/goliath-65b-v2/`. LMK if you get access denied.
Anya Patel: thanks all. if Mike posts the final checksum table i'll run the mirror and then trigger `./deploy/onboard --manifest s3://redwood-artifacts/models/goliath-65b-v2/manifest.json`. will follow up with smoke logs.
Mike Huang: checksum table posted: `ckpt-0001.bin 3a1f2b..., ckpt-0002.bin b4d8e1..., ...`. matches per-shard mode. Jen — once your tokenizer patch lands, i'll re-run validator.
Jen Ortega: patch up, PR #927 in tokenizers landed. added fallback and clearer error msg. :rocket:
Anya Patel: awesome. closing loop — mirror started, will update thread with `onboard` job logs and final CI status. thanks everyone.
